affinity.notes: Cyan and violet appear to be feather highlights; the creature remains physical rather than elementally constructed.

anatomy.notes: Torso, arms, legs, and trailing feathers overlap into an uncertain body structure.

archetype.notes: Aerial assassin does not communicate the intended crossing-lane specialist duty.

counterplay.notes: The airborne posture indicates mobility, but obscured limbs and weapon details leave attack direction and recovery behavior unclear.

finish.notes: Dark values become muddy against the storm background, while cyan and violet accents feel disconnected.

framing.notes: Isolated airborne subject is centered and fully contained.

identity.notes: Dark harpy identifies the Skyrender form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T3; exact intended tier is T3.
